title: Dreamy MineGit
description: A Github like mod for players builds!
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/d3IV0oPC77s" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe># **MineGit**

MineGit is a mod inspired by Github, using this mod you can take your build and upload them in our discord server for players to be able to get them and try them out!

## **How to use?**
First when you join the worl you need to use**

**/minegit give all**
after using this command you will get 8 tools

### The Saver
It's used to select the 2 corners of your build to save it!
after right clicking the 2 corners press "Shift + Right click" to save it

### The Loader
It's used to load your builds or builds from other players
just right click it in the ground to load the GUI tu put the GitCode and load the build, and if you press "shift + right click" it will open a menu that you can unload the build!

### Configs 
It's a item used to configure the mod the way you wanna yo!

### Repository
It's basicly the same thing as the github repositorys that allow users to update their project withou making a new one!

### Rotate
It's a tool used to rotate or flip your build the way you wanna to!

### Randomizer
It's a tool that allow's you to put as much builds you want inside of it to put them randomly in the world, very helpfull when building rocks!

### Undo/Redo
It's a tool used to undo your mess and if you hit the air with it it turn's into a tool called Redo that's used to remake something that you deleted using the Undo!

### Tool Visualizer
A tool that when you put it in your off hand it set's your hotbar with all the items the mod have!
